task.prompt: Set an execution breakpoint at the code address the console expression PlayerX+2 evaluates to, with breakpoint_at forced to read its ref as an expression rather than as a symbol or an address.

lines: M55: CANNOT breakpoint_at takes only a symbol or a linear 0x address and refuses expressions; an expression place has no declaration here, so an expression-based halt is only possible through regpoint_add.
M55: CANNOT breakpoint_at refuses by "expr" (a halt on an expression is regpoint_add's job), and regpoint_add takes no address-of-expression ref.
M55: CANNOT Breakpoints take only places (`auto`, `symbol` or `address`), and an expression is refused there; a halt on an expression belongs to `regpoint_add`.
